CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 15

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

7. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 9
   D. 4

10. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

14. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 50

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
